brief:
Lebanese President Joseph Aoun said Israel continues to violate the framework agreement through ongoing bombardment and destruction of southern villages, including areas it occupies, Shehab Wire reported. The president cited the demolition of homes and property as evidence of the violations.

Aoun made the remarks during a meeting with the commerce minister. He characterized Israel's military operations in Lebanon's south as a systematic breach of the terms governing the ceasefire arrangement between the two countries.
